description:
Requirement: 
 Position: SharePoint Developer 

 Job Location: Ft. Worth, TX 76155
 Duration: 6+ Months CTH (100% Full Time after 6 months)
 Description: 
 This position is a unique position that will design branding solutions and user interfaces for customers. Ideal candidate must have strong working knowledge of SharePoint customization and development. This candidate will have excellent verbal and written communication as well as the ability to understand business requirements. Working knowledge of SharePoint designer is a must. A thorough understanding of SharePoint architecture(site collection, site, list and pages) and SharePoint Features also needed. Ability to create user interfaces by leveraging graphics and media tools is a must have. 
 • 5+ years of experience as a Graphic Designer and User Experience Designer 
 • Must be proficient in HTML, CSS, JavaScript/JQuery, Photoshop Illustrator, SharePoint Designer 2010/2013 
 • Expertise in SharePoint branding and customization. 
 • Experience in building Collaboration solutions using Microsoft SharePoint Server 2010/2013 
 • Ability to design, test and implement SharePoint branding solutions are must. 
 • Extensive experience in XML and related technologies (XSLT, XPATH etc.). 
 • Strong working knowledge in web 2.0 
 • Knowledge of Excel Services, SharePoint workflows, InfoPath forms, ECMA scripts, Angular JS and REST services 
 • Working knowledge of SharePoint Permission, Search and My site. 
 • Familiar with SharePoint 2013 (new features)
 


 Must Have: 
 • CSS
 • HTML
 • JavaScript
 • jQuery
 • Photoshop
 • SharePoint *
 • XML
 • XSLT
 Nice to Have: 
 • Airline Experience
 


 
 Thanks & Regards, 
 Caroline Ignetious 
 Caroline(dot)i(at)tekwissen.com 
 734-984-4499
